title: Critique: phi measures global information transfer, not consciousness

statements.text: What phi measures is the causal efficacy with which differentiated networks accomplish global information transfer. Identifying that with consciousness forces the attribution of consciousness to power grids, gene-regulation networks and social networks.

sources.quote: Our analysis shows that IIT's identification of consciousness with the causal efficacy with which differentiated networks accomplish global information transfer (which is what Φ in fact measures) is mistaken.
